intro: Search realestate.com.au agents and agencies by suburb, postcode or search link and get names, contact details, agency, listing counts, median sold price and active suburbs.
useCases: Build agent prospect lists by suburb
Rank agencies by listings and sold prices
Map who is active in a postcode

faq.q: Is there an API for realestate.com.au agents?
faq.a: No public one. This actor searches agents and agencies by suburb, postcode or link and returns their agency, listing counts, median sold price and active suburbs.

faq.q: Can I use it as a realestate.com.au agents API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: REA Group's APIs are for agencies publishing their own listings; agent directories are not offered as data. This actor reads the public agent and agency profiles on realestate.com.au.
